objectives.name: time_growth
objectives.semantics: The exact rational g(B_T) in rules.md for the total-work envelope in claim 0. Establish all four original resource statements, scores and any structured bounds for the same algorithm/configuration jointly. Only time is a numeric objective; both memory guarantees and sample complexity remain mandatory. Equal time scores do not imply equal guarantees. The fifth error-tolerance expression and its error model are reviewed jointly, with no tolerance score.

scoring.instructions: Apply rules.md. Establish every original claim exactly as written, including all four full resource statements, nonnegative rational growth indices and every declared structured object. All four bounds must hold jointly for the same algorithm/configuration. Return scores:null; after atomic acceptance derive only time_growth from claim 0. Missing memory or sample claims or an unsupported stronger guarantee cannot be accepted. Establish the fifth error-tolerance count expression and its explicit error model jointly with the same algorithm and resource bounds. It has no numeric score. Zero states only a clean-input guarantee, not a proved impossibility of robustness. The tolerance expression must use the sample-tolerance-v1 count family in rules.md. Establish its original rounded-count guarantee under its error model; do not turn it into a numeric tolerance score.

validity.instructions: Apply rules.md to unconditional full-secret correctness and jointly charged worst-case resources. Every submission, including partial/unscored or validity-only work, must contain all four supported structured resource bounds with exact nonnegative indices. Missing, malformed or unsupported declarations are format rejection, not unscored acceptance. Format admission does not prove a claim: establish all exact statements and declared structured objects for the same algorithm/configuration, domain, model and evidence. Never infer coefficients or normalization from prose or hints. Reject mathematical mismatches.
